title: •General Walex Blissex
caption: •General Walex Blissex (V)
game_text: {pilot:1}. While piloting a capital starship at a battleground system, in each battle a player’s first battle destiny draw may not be canceled or reduced and if opponent canceled a just drawn battle destiny, they lose 1 Force.
lore: Engineer who worked with Jan Dodonna to design the A-wing starfighter. Given honorary rank due to his service to the Rebellion.
